query: RTX 5080 Super price November 2026 in stock review launch
answer: As of November 9, 2026, the RTX 5080 Super's price and stock status remain uncertain. While the RTX 5080 16GB has seen significant price hikes, with prices in the US now 120% over the MSRP at $2,200, the RTX 5080 Super is rumored to upgrade the memory to 24GB but its launch is on hold due to 3GB GDDR7 pricing issues. The RTX 5080 Super's launch timeline is uncertain, with some reports suggesting a potential delay to 2027 due to supply constraints and shifting GPU priorities toward AI. The RTX 5080 Super's price is not given in the sources.

results.title: The 'probability is extremely high' that Nvidia's rumored RTX 5080 Super has been delayed, and with GPU prices rocketing upwards, the future looks bleak | TechRadar
results.content:
What TechSpot's monitoring data for October 2026 shows is that, as we already knew, high-end pricing has gone even further off the rails. The RTX 5080 is up 39% in the US and 40% in Germany month-on-month, for example, which is ludicrous, frankly — in the US it's now 120% over the MSRP at $2,200. The UK has seen an 8% hike over the past month, with this GPU now 40% over its MSRP in the country. Globally, it's 77% over Nvidia's recommended price on average. [...] The RTX 5060 is creeping up in price in some European countries, too — it's up 7% in the UK and 13% in Germany. The RTX 5060 Ti 8GB has gone up more, with this GPU getting hiked by 10% in the UK, so it's now £440 compared to £350 back at the start of 2026. The 5060 Ti 8GB went up 6% in the US, too, so it's now 40% over the MSRP in total. [...] We were told via other rumor peddlers that the 24GB spin on the RTX 5080 is theoretically planned for a January 2027 launch, but Benchlife asserts that the release date "remains unclear" and that Nvidia's board manufacturing partners have yet to receive any design details for the new model.

results.title: NVIDIA Reportedly Moves Up RTX 5080 24 GB Launch | TechPowerUp
results.content:
NVIDIA's GeForce RTX 5080 24 GB might arrive sooner than expected. A new post from Board Channels' ChannelGate account claims NVIDIA is speeding up the launch, with availability now expected around January 2027 and December 2026 as the earliest option. Earlier this month, various sources relayed that the card was reportedly planned for Q1 2027. The same post says NVIDIA will stop supplying the RTX 5080 16 GB and the RTX 5090 D V2 to China, leaving the 24 GB RTX 5080 as the only flagship model [...] cost around 19,999 yuan (nearly $3,000) in China, while the 16 GB model already sells for close to $2,000 at U.S. retailers, double its $999 MSRP. With the memory shortage expected to get worse in 2027, it's reasonable to expect the 24 GB card to be both expensive and hard to find.
